source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Any change in renal function requiring the immediate discontinuation of all of the client's heart failure medications at the exact same moment, no matter how minor","B":"Renal function monitoring being relevant mainly for clients who already have pre-existing, diagnosed kidney disease, rather than for heart failure clients broadly","C":"These particular medications carrying fairly little relevant effect on the client's overall renal function throughout the entire course of their treatment","D":"These medications can affect renal function, and monitoring helps detect and appropriately manage any significant changes while balancing the substantial cardiovascular benefits of continued therapy"}}
source_row.rationale: Renal function monitoring is important for clients on heart failure GDMT (including ACE inhibitor/ARNI and diuretics) because these medications can affect renal function, and monitoring helps detect and appropriately manage significant changes while balancing the substantial established cardiovascular benefits of continued guideline-directed therapy.
source_row.source_detail: Balancing Renal Monitoring with GDMT Benefits
